descriptions.description: OpenSSH 10.6p1 for iPad 2 and other ARMv7 devices running iOS 5.
Provides SSH client and server tools. The server supports password authentication and starts through the Cydia-compatible launch daemon.

change.changeDescription: Initial Marchrius build for iOS 5 and ARMv7.
Uses OpenSSL 3.5.8 and the resource-limit sandbox compatible with iOS 5.
